focus: A tool we use to repair the site after two changes collide had been quietly reporting success over only the part of the site it knew about, which is why a check failed twice after everything local looked fine. It now checks the parts it cannot map as well, and refuses to say "clean" when it has not looked. Separately, one of our alarms reported all-clear for a condition it had never actually seen happen; it now says so, so a quiet alarm cannot be mistaken for a tested one. Nothing visitors see changed this session.
nextStep: Send the first member newsletter, and decide how often The Desk should publish.
